chapters.label: Live: the 2024 league final
chapters.text: The 2024 Spanish league final. Jimbee Cartagena lead ElPozo Murcia by two goals, ten minutes left. Marlon shoots from point-blank range. Chemi blocks it!

chapters.label: Replay: the reverse angle
chapters.text: Watch from the other side. Chemi makes himself big, and the ball hits him. Jimbee won five to two, their first league title!

chapters.label: How he does it (demo)
chapters.text: How he does it: on a close, low shot, drop one knee and slide the other leg wide. The bottom of the goal is covered.

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Drop into a split to cover the low corners on quick futsal shots. Knee down, leg out!
